_comment: Triaged, accepted-pending-upgrade advisories. All are framework-transitive via Payload + Next. As of 2026-08-01 the tree runs Next 16.2.12 with overrides for postcss, sharp, immutable, js-yaml and fast-uri, so the previously un-allowlisted advisories are FIXED rather than accepted; the entries below are the residual ones with no compatible patch. Remediation: re-run scripts/audit-ci.mjs after each Next or Payload upgrade and delete any entry that no longer appears. Tracked in docs/SECURITY.md. Any high/critical advisory NOT listed here fails CI.
